steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up Gradle build settings, target SDK 34, Java 8 source compatibility, and app-meta configuration.

steps.title: Define Application Schemas
steps.description: Establish offline api_schema.json and admin_setting_schema.json configurations.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Define AndroidManifest.xml with fullscreen hardware-accelerated game activity and orientation lock.

steps.title: Create Color Palette and Theme Styles
steps.description: Add dark arcade theme colors, fruit tint constants, and fullscreen style definitions.

steps.title: Implement Haptic and Audio Effects Helper
steps.description: Create SoundHelper for haptic vibration pulses and synthesized audio feedback during slicing and explosions.

steps.title: Create Particle and Juice Splash Engine
steps.description: Implement juice droplet particles and bomb fire sparks with realistic physics and alpha fading.

steps.title: Implement Touch Blade Trail Mechanics
steps.description: Construct swipe gesture tracker with decaying blade trail, glowing neon strokes, and line-segment collision detection.

steps.title: Design Fruit and Bomb Entity Model
steps.description: Develop Fruit class supporting Watermelon, Apple, Banana, Orange, Strawberry, and Bomb with split half rendering and gravity.

steps.title: Build Real-Time Game Canvas View
steps.description: Develop GameView with 60 FPS game loop, spawning waves, slice hit-testing, combo calculation, screen shake, and HUD rendering.

steps.title: Design Main Game Screen Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout hosting the custom GameView and overlay containers.

steps.title: Implement Main Game Activity Controller
steps.description: Set up MainActivity with fullscreen lifecycle management, high-score handling, and touch event coordination.

steps.title: Building Slice Master
steps.description: Compile, package, and assemble the debug APK for Slice Master.
